scope: Source-runtime POSIX service-manager termination and disposable Linux server restart/backup/restore. No actual personal VM deployment or desktop packaging.

reproduced_before_fix.cause: SIGTERM used the process default action; the real CLI exited by signal before StudioService.close could run.

changes: A main-thread Studio launch now handles SIGTERM by setting a cooperative stop event, without raising inside state operations.
HTTP shutdown runs outside serve_forever; worker-only mode ends its wait and both reuse the existing service cleanup.
Repeated SIGTERM remains cooperative during cleanup; previous signal handling is restored on return/error. Embedded thread launches retain host policy.
A stop received during initialization closes the service before listening or operational dispatch.
Added a thin public-API example, explicit POSIX process acceptance and repeatable Linux test image; no persisted formats or HTTP payloads changed.
verified: File and SQLite workspaces each survive normal termination, SIGKILL restart and an inactive restored-copy launch: four real CLI launches per backend.
Every live controller rejects a second writer with exit status 75; no listener survives a terminated controller.
Existing agent/workflow definitions and paused approval remain readable; no extra run is created.
Original and replacement artifact bytes survive; lexical retrieval still cites original pinned revision 1.
Instrumented real controller/SQL-worker close methods finish after two SIGTERM signals, including a signal received during cleanup.
Existing file/SQL backup, integrity checks, inactive restores, workspace ownership and native parent-pipe regressions pass on both hosts.

validation.warning: One existing SQLAlchemy memory-URL pool-selection deprecation per host, from the rejected ephemeral-target fixture. No failures or skips.
validation.lint: Ruff passes for the changed runtime, helper, consumer and tests; git diff --check passes.

linux_image.build_scope: Only source package, metadata, selected tests/legacy fixtures and three example consumers were staged. Build explicitly downloaded test dependencies. No credentials or personal workspace were copied.
